# Goku

> Bookmark ingestion and management, in four deployable pieces: a Go HTTP API over SQLite, a Go CLI, an MQTT consumer that batches URLs into the API, and a React web UI. Built for bulk import of large browser exports.

Status: production
Interfaces: http, cli
Entrypoint: API on `:8080`, base path `/api/v1`; `goku` CLI binary; consumer subscribes to an MQTT topic and posts to the API
Auth: none. The API has no authentication of any kind — do not expose it to an untrusted network.
Spec: none — no OpenAPI document exists. The route list below was read from `api/api/v1/router.go` and is authoritative.

This directory has no `README.md`; each of the four components has its own. There is no single place that describes how they fit together, so: the CLI and the consumer are both producers against the API, the API owns the SQLite database, and the web UI talks to the API over HTTP.

The API serves five bookmark operations plus a health check, all under `/api/v1`:

- `POST /api/v1/upload` — upload new bookmarks (the batch entry point the consumer uses)
- `GET /api/v1/bookmarks` — retrieve all bookmarks
- `GET /api/v1/bookmark?url=...` — retrieve one bookmark by URL
- `PUT /api/v1/bookmark` — update an existing bookmark
- `DELETE /api/v1/bookmark/:id` — delete by ID
- `GET /api/v1/health` — health check

**`api/README.md` lists these paths without the `/api/v1` prefix and omits the health check.** The code mounts the whole group at `/api/v1` (`api/cmd/api/main.go`), so the README's paths return 404. `consumer/README.md` repeats the error in its `API_ENDPOINT=http://your-goku-api:8080/upload` example; the working value ends in `/api/v1/upload`. Use the list above, not either README, until they are corrected.

The CLI covers `add`, `get`, `list`, `search`, `update`, `delete`, `purge`, `import`, `export`, `tag`, `fetch`, `sync` and `stats`, with multi-user profiles and a bulk-import path intended for 100k+ bookmarks.

## Interface reference

- [api/README.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/goku/api/README.md): build, run, Docker and the configuration environment variables (`PORT`, `DB_PATH`). Its endpoint list is stale — see above.
- [cli/README.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/goku/cli/README.md): the CLI's features, installation and worked examples for import, search, export and profiles. The most complete document in the project.
- [consumer/README.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/goku/consumer/README.md): the MQTT consumer's configuration — `MQTT_BROKER`, `TOPIC`, `CLIENT_ID`, `BATCH_SIZE`, `API_ENDPOINT` — settable by environment variable or `config.json`.
- [api/api/v1/router.go](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/goku/api/api/v1/router.go): the route definitions themselves, and the reason the list above differs from the README.

## Optional

- [cli/docs/PRD.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/goku/cli/docs/PRD.md): the CLI's product requirements.
- [web/README.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/goku/web/README.md): a stub. The UI is a Vite, React and TypeScript application using TipTap and axios; read `web/package.json` instead.
- [cli/scripts/README.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/goku/cli/scripts/README.md): maintenance and validation scripts.
